name: Highlands County, FL
findings: Highlands County has 319 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 90 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Highlands County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 22 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.
